name: Spine Mutation
body:
By tapping into your ancestry you can force yourself to grow a handful of spines per day that you can launch from your body.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): You can grow 1d6 spines per day, after resting for 8 hours, on your shell. They may be drawn and thrown as if they were javalines that are stored in an easily accessible place. A tarrasqueling with the feat may never have more than 6 spines at one time. These spines do not increase the weight of the tarrasqueling.
